How to get it :
- [[gv:machine_precass|Precision Assembly Machine]] : 16 x [[gv:circuit_chip_bismoid|Versatile Integrated Circuit]], 48 x [[gv:circuit_capacitor_tantalium|Tantalum Capacitor]], [[gv:circuit_atomic_clock|Atomic Clock]], [[gv:circuit_controller_chassis|Control Unit Casing]], [[gv:upgrade_speed_3|Speed Upgrade Mk.III]], 24 x wire (Lead), 4000 mB perfluoromethyl.
- [[Soldering Station|Soldering Station]] : 4000 mB perfluoromethyl, 16 x [[gv:circuit_chip_bismoid|Versatile Integrated Circuit]], 48 x [[gv:circuit_capacitor_tantalium|Tantalum Capacitor]], [[gv:circuit_atomic_clock|Atomic Clock]], [[gv:circuit_controller_chassis|Control Unit Casing]], 4 x ingot (hard plastic), 24 x wire (Lead).

Used to make :
[[gv:satellite_miner_astro|Asteroid Mining Ship]], [[gv:satellite_death_ray|Orbital Death Ray]], [[gv:satellite_detector|Wideband Radio Emission Detector Satellite]], [[gv:missile_soyuz_lander|Orbital Module]], [[gv:launchpad_lambda|Lambda Launch Pad]], [[gv:launchpad_soyuz|Soyuz Launch Pad]], [[gv:satellite_miner_lunar|Lunar Mining Ship]], [[gv:satellite_precision_laser|Orbital Precision Laser]], [[gv:satellite_ray_scan|Narrowband Emission Scanning Satellite]], [[gv:satellite_xenium_resonator|Xenium Resonator Satellite]] and 1 more.
